2025-07-01.name: Necronomico no Cosmic Horror Show
2025-07-01.desc:
Kurono Miko, also known as Necronomico, graduates from middle school and decides to pursue her dreams of becoming a streamer. One day, as she's with her childhood friend, Mayusaka Mayu, and her rival, Kagurazaka Kanna, she accepts an offer to play a new VR game. The game gives Miko the opportunity to take on mysterious challenges with other unique streamers she meets within the VR world.

Source: Crunchyroll

Note: The first two episodes received an early screening at a special event on 1 June 2025 at United Cinemas Toyosu in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 1 July 2025.

2025-07-02.name: Clevatess: Majuu no Ou to Akago to Shikabane no Yuusha
2025-07-02.desc:
One of the Lords of Dark Beasts, Clevatess's reign shatters when he revives a hero he personally slayed and adopts an orphaned humanoid baby—the last hope to save a dying world. Now bound together, what fate awaits this unlikely trio?

Source: Crunchyroll

Note: The first episode received an early screening at a special event on 15 June 2025 at Grand Cinema Sunshine Ikebukuro in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 2 July 2025.

2025-07-02.name: Jidouhanbaiki ni Umarekawatta Ore wa Meikyuu o Samayou 2nd Season
2025-07-02.desc: * Based on an isekai fantasy light novel written by Hirukuma and illustrated by Katou Itsuwa.

2025-07-02.name: Jigoku Sensei Nube (2025)
2025-07-02.desc:
* Based on an occult manga, with story by Makura Shou and art by Okano Takeshi, serialized in Shueisha's Weekly Shounen Jump magazine from 1993 to 1999.

A number of inexplicable phenomena have been plaguing the town of Domori. In order to protect the town's children, a new homeroom teacher known as "Nube" arrives.
Normally gentle and a bit outgoing, Nube has a secret side: he is, in fact, the only psychic teacher in Japan. Rumor also has it his left hand is possessed by a demon! Hell's messenger of justice is here to take on the school's seven mysteries, ghosts, and evil spirits attacking his students.

Source: Official Website

Note: The first two episodes received an early screening at a special event on 7 June 2025 at TOHO Cinemas Ueno in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 2 July 2025.

2025-07-02.name: Ling Tian Du Zun
2025-07-02.desc:
Ling Tian, a sword saint of his generation, went against the will of heaven to seize the stele in order to save his beloved, but was plotted against by the way of heaven. When he fell, he perished together with the way of heaven, but was unexpectedly reborn, returning to the moment of his death three hundred years ago when his dantian was completely destroyed and his sword bone was taken away. His beauty is still there, his old enemy is still there, and he has been on the long road to becoming a saint, so why not start over? In this life, he vows to rewrite his destiny and make up for his regrets!

source: MAL

2025-07-03.name: Ginga Tokkyuu: Milky Subway
2025-07-03.desc:
Super human Chiharu and cyborg Makina got arrested for breaking space traffic laws.
They're stuck with a crew of misfits who got caught around the same time: Akane and Kanata, the super human pair; and Kurt and Max, the cyborg pals. Ryoko, the police officer,
sentenced them to clean up the interplanetary train – the so-called "Milky☆Subway,"
as their community service.

It should've been a simple job – until the train suddenly takes off into deep space!

Source: Official English Website

2025-07-03.name: Tsuihousha Shokudou e Youkoso!
2025-07-03.desc:
Backstabbed by those he considered friends, Dennis has been exiled from one of the strongest guilds around: the Silver Wings Battalion. He doesn't think much of it, though, as he was dying to use his level 99 cooking skills anyway. That's why he decides to leave the city behind and open up a diner in the countryside. While pursuing his dream, Dennis meets Atelier, a girl exiled from her noble household and relegated to slavery until he saves her. The pair open the diner together, and their first client is... an exiled knight from a different guild? How peculiar. But she is not the only customer; a cocky mage and a drastically overworked yet underpaid sage become regulars as well. The knight brings trouble to the diner at times, but Dennis's cooking skills and beloved butcher knives cut through trouble and hunger alike! Thus begins the legend of Dennis and his diner, the talk of the town!

Source: Tentai Books

2025-07-03.name: Tsuyokute New Saga
2025-07-03.desc:
* Based on a fantasy light novel written by Abe Masayuki and illustrated by Fuse Ryuuta.

After a brutal war, magic swordsman Kyle defeats the Demon King but is left dying. A crimson crystal sends him four years into the past to his once-destroyed hometown where he finds his lost loved ones alive. Armed with future knowledge, Kyle vows to prevent the coming tragedy and rewrite fate.

Source: Crunchyroll

2025-07-04.name: Arknights: Rise from Ember
2025-07-04.desc:
* Based on a tower defense mobile game developed by Chinese developer Hypergryph.

After Reunion is routed and Lungmen secured, Kal'tsit delivers grim news to those gathered in Wei Yenwu's office—Talulah has detached the core city plate of Chernobog and set it on a direct course toward Lungmen. Making matters worse, Chernobog is still officially an Ursus city. If the two nomadic cities collide or engage in open conflict, it could ignite a catastrophic war between Ursus and Yan—a war neither nation can afford. In the meantime, the Doctor brings FrostNova's corpse to Rhodes Island's bioprocessing unit and meets Rosmontis.

Source: Arknights Terra Wiki

2025-07-04.name: Busu ni Hanataba o.
2025-07-04.desc:
* Based on a romantic comedy manga by Sakura Roku.

Tabata Hana is a first-year high school student who self-deprecates herself as an ugly girl (busu). She comes to school early morning to do her daily classroom flower exchange. Hana likes this time so much that she takes pleasure in putting a flower on her head, but Ueno Yousuke, the most handsome boy in her class who happens to arrive at school early, sees her doing it. Yousuke has always been curious about the person changing the flowers in the classroom, and when he finds out that it is Hana, the two gradually grow closer. However, the distance between Hana, who refuses numerous opportunities for progress, and Yousuke, who is innocent and ignorant when it comes to love, continues to be difficult to close.

Source: Crunchyroll News

2025-07-04.name: Dan Da Dan (2025)
2025-07-04.desc:
* Based on a paranormal mystery battle & romantic comedy manga by Tatsu Yukinobu.

Note: The first three episodes received an early screening at a special event on 29 June 2025 at United Cinemas Toyosu in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 4 July 2025.

2025-07-04.name: Mizu Zokusei no Mahou Tsukai
2025-07-04.desc:
Ryou is delighted to be reincarnated into the fantastical world of Phi, where he thinks he'll get to live a quiet life learning to use his newfound water magic. Going with the flow here, however, means something very different. Ryou is immediately pitted against the wild lands he winds up in and the slew of deadly monsters that call the remote subcontinent home. You'd think he'd forget about taking it easy when he's stuck fighting for his life, but lucky for Ryou, he's naturally optimistic, clever, and blessed with the hidden "Eternal Youth" trait. Twenty years pass in the blink of an eye, and each encounter along the way pushes him one step closer to the pinnacle of human magic. Little does he realize that's only the opening chapter of his tale. A fateful meeting soon thrusts Ryou to the forefront of history, forever changing the course of his life... Thus begins the adventures of the strongest water magician the world has ever seen—who also likes to do things at his own pace!

Source: J-Novel Club

2025-07-04.name: Sugar Sugar Rune: Les Deux Sorcieres
2025-07-04.desc: A short film commemorating the 20th anniversary of the serialization of "Sugar Sugar Rune".

2025-07-04.name: Yofukashi no Uta Season 2
2025-07-04.desc:
Kou overcomes his confusion about becoming a vampire and decides to "like" Nazuna, while Nazuna resolves to make Kou "fall in love" with her. Without understanding what "love" even is, the two of them spend their nights together in a frenzy. Meanwhile, Detective Uguisu Anko is closing in with her plot to kill vampires, not just Nazuna. A vampire's weakness is "anything they were attached to when they were human" and so they all try to get rid of this weakness before it's too late. But, Nazuna has no memory of her human life. What is Nazuna's hidden past? Why did Anko start killing vampires? And what is the "secret" that Nazuna and Anko share? For Kou, Nazuna, Anko, a fun "late night" doesn't end here... a new "night" begins!

Source: HIDIVE

Note: The first three episodes received an early screening at a special event on 14 June 2025 at United Cinemas Toyosu in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 4 July 2025.

2025-07-05.name: 9: Ruler`s Crown
2025-07-05.desc:
Shiromitsugawa, a run-of-the-mill college town that has launched several failed attempts to drum up tourism and revitalize itself, including sponsoring a high-budget-but-poorly-written anime based on local folklore. A storm is about to descend on this sleepy town.

Niimi Kakeru is a man who can be a bit curt at times but who has a strong sense of responsibility and a kind heart. Kakeru's ordinary life is thrown into chaos after the local shrine's sacred relic shatters. In the wake of this event, several young men and women awaken to superhuman abilities. What was once a run-of-the-mill life in a run-of-the-mill town soon turns into a quest to track down a superpowered serial killer before they can strike again.

Source: Sekai Project

Note: The first two episodes received an early screening at a special event on 15 June 2025 at Parthenon Tama in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 5 July 2025.

2025-07-05.name: Cardfight!! Vanguard: Divinez Deluxe Kesshou Hen
Fermat no Ryouri
2025-07-05.desc:
Kitada Gaku is a prodigy in Mathematics and a scholarship holder at Wels Private Academy, a renowned institution with a long history in the International Mathematical Olympiad. After a series of unfortunate events, he meets Asakura Kai, a culinary prodigy with his own catering business. What does the future hold for these two geniuses, and how do their paths intertwine with each other's?

Source: M-U

Note: The first episode received an early screening at a special event on 15 June 2025 at Cine Libre Ikebukuro in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 5 July 2025.

2025-07-05.name: Kizetsu Yuusha to Ansatsu Hime
2025-07-05.desc:
The hero Toto has talent, but his shyness has prevented him from forming a party. As he languishes in the town of origins, three beautiful women—Ciel, Anemone, and Goa—invite Toto to join their party out of the blue. Toto gears up to begin the journey, but unbeknownst to him, all three women are plotting to kill him for their own reasons!

Source: Crunchyroll

2025-07-05.name: Seishun Buta Yarou wa Santa Claus no Yume o Minai
2025-07-05.desc:
Puberty Syndrome...
A bizarre phenomenon rumored to be triggered by an unstable mental state.

After encountering various girls going through Puberty Syndrome, Azusagawa Sakuta's high school days have come to a close, and he is now a university student. He enrolls at a university in Kanazawa-hakkei alongside his girlfriend Sakurajima Mai, a nationally famed actress. Off campus, he stumbles upon an out-of-season miniskirt Santa.

"I'm surprised. So, you can see me."

This is a phrase he's heard somewhere before. This miniskirt Santa, who claims to be gifting Puberty Syndrome to people, tells Sakuta...

"My name... is Kirishima Toko."

Precognitive dreams, an anonymous online singer, poltergeists buzzing on social media... A mysterious tale with enigmatic phenomenons surrounding girls with wavering hearts starts again.
Puberty continues...

Source: Official Website

Note: The first two episodes received an early screening at a special event on 21 June 2025 at United Cinemas Aqua City Odaiba in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 5 July 2025.

2025-07-05.name: Silent Witch: Chinmoku no Majo no Kakushigoto
2025-07-05.desc:
Monica Everett, the Silent Witch, is the only mage in the world who can use unchanted magecraft, a true hero who singlehandedly defeated a legendary black dragon. However, this young genius is actually...super-duper shy! That's right: She learned to cast spells silently just to avoid speaking in public, and despite her power, she has zero self-confidence. Now Monica has been tasked with secretly guarding the second prince. Can she keep it together as she faces both the evil forces targeting the prince and the terrors of social interaction?

Source: Yen Press

Note: The first two episodes received an early screening at a special event on 21 June 2025 at United Cinemas Toyosu in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 5 July 2025.

2025-07-05.name: Watari-kun no xx ga Houkaisunzen
2025-07-05.desc:
* Based on a love comedy manga by Narumi Naru.

Watari Naoto has had his share of struggles: his parents died two years ago, and now he and his sister live at his aunt's house. There, his desire to protect his sister earned him notoriety as "the guy with the sister complex"—which never mattered to him, as his sister always came first. But when Satsuki, a childhood friend-turned-enemy(?), becomes his school mate, Naoto's ordinary life is thrown into chaos ... and Satsuki may just be the beginning.

Source: Kodansha

Note: The first two episodes received an early screening at a special event on 30 June 2025 at United Cinemas Aqua City Odaiba in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 5 July 2025.

2025-07-05.name: Yun Shen Buzhi Meng
2025-07-05.desc:
A beautiful wedding turns into betrayal by a beloved. No longer seeking immortality, a single thought transforms into darkness. The powerful and tragic heroine embarks on a path of vengeance as a killing deity, determined to eradicate all.

source: MAL

2025-07-05.name: Zutaboro Reijou wa Ane no Moto Kon`yakusha ni Dekiai Sareru
2025-07-05.desc:
Marie, the second daughter of a poor baron’s household, is treated like a servant by her parents. Even at Marie’s birthday party, her beautiful elder sister, Anastasia, is the star. Outside, Marie bumps into Count Kyuros Granado, who falls for her at first sight. Yet, due to a misunderstanding, the Count proposes to Anastasia. After a tragic accident, Marie must marry the count instead!

Source: Crunchyroll

2025-07-06.name: Ame to Kimi to
2025-07-06.desc:
If it looks like a dog and acts like a dog and insists it's a dog, it's...a dog? Probably? She adopted it anyway, and her life with this "dog" will never be boring!

Source: Kodansha

Note: The first episode received an early screening at a special event on 29 June 2025 at United Cinemas Minato Mirai in Yokohama. The regular TV broadcast started on 6 July 2025.

2025-07-06.name: Bad Girl
2025-07-06.desc:
Yuutani Yuu is a first-year high school student with sharp eyes, large piercings and flashy two-tone hair. She's become notorious as a bad girl... but she's really not. At heart, Yuu is an incredibly good girl, but her mind is always full of thoughts of the beautiful and popular Mizutori Atori, the school's Madonna and head of the student disciplinary committee. So, on her mission to attract the attention of Atori, Yuu decided to quit being an honor student and become a "bad delinquent!"

Source: HIDIVE

2025-07-06.name: Busamen Gachi Fighter
2025-07-06.desc:
His looks are -255, touching girls causes him pain, and sexual acts will literally tear him apart. Just what can our ex-salesman Shigeru get in the other world in exchange for such inconveniences...? This is an epic tale of one very ugly, but ridiculously strong man!

Source: Comikey

2025-07-06.name: Dekin no Mogura
2025-07-06.desc:
One day, university students Maki and Yaeko encounter a man injured by a Kojien (Japanese Dictionary) that fell from the sky. The man is bleeding from the head and refuses to go to an ambulance or the police, but there is something wrong with him. Furthermore, after meeting this man, Maki and Yaeko begin to see strange things.

In this complicated and mysterious town, the absurd and the mysterious are not to be questioned! Be careful not to go too deep...

Source: M-U

2025-07-06.name: Gachiakuta
2025-07-06.desc:
Rudo lives in the slums of a floating town, where the poor scrape by under the shadow of the rich who live a sumptuous life, simply casting their garbage off the side, into the abyss. Then one day, he's falsely accused of murder, and his wrongful conviction leads to an unimaginable punishment—exile off the edge, with the rest of the trash. Down on the surface, the cast-off waste of humanity has bred vicious monsters, and if Rudo wants to have any hope of discovering the truth and seeking vengeance against those who cast him into Hell, he will have to master a new power and join a group known as the Cleaners who battle the hulking trash beasts of the Pit!

Source: Kodansha

Note: The first two episodes received early screenings at special events on 4 July 2025 at Shinjuku Piccadilly in Tokyo, Japan Expo in Paris, Anime Expo in Los Angeles, in Rome, in São Paulo, in Mumbai and on 5 July 2025 in Berlin. The regular TV broadcast started on 6 July 2025.

2025-07-06.name: Geesen Shoujo to Ibunka Kouryuu
2025-07-06.desc:
Kusakabe Renji, a young man working at a game centre, sees an English girl named Lily Baker playing a crane game on Valentine's Day. Seeing her fail repeatedly to win a prize, Renji can't help but take action. The day after Lily finally gets her plushie, Renji receives an unexpected message from her that reads, "Be my valentine!" What started as a misunderstanding leads to cultural exchange!

Source: Crunchyroll

Note: The first three episodes received an early screening at a special event on 28 June 2025 at Kino Cinéma Shinjuku in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 6 July 2025.

2025-07-06.name: Hikaru ga Shinda Natsu
2025-07-06.desc:
Two best friends living in a rural Japanese village: Yoshiki and Hikaru. Growing up together, they were inseparable... until the day Hikaru came back from the mountains, and was no longer himself. "Something" has taken over Hikaru's body, memories, feelings... and everything they know begins to unravel.

Source: Netflix

Note: The first episode received an early screening at a special event on 29 June 2025 at TOHO Cinemas Shinjuku in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 6 July 2025.

2025-07-06.name: Hotel Inhumans
2025-07-06.desc:
The best hotels must meet certain standards, including the finest cuisine, ways to relax, and entertainment. Of course, they also need the best selection of weapons, reliable ways to falsify one's identity, and ways to dispose of evidence. In this hotel at the border of death stand two concierges, Hoshi Ikurou and Haizaki Sara. What kinds of requests will the assassins have for them next?

Source: Crunchyroll

Note: The first two episodes received an early screening at a special event on 29 June 2025 at Ikebukuro HUMAX Cinemas in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 6 July 2025.

2025-07-06.name: Isekai Mokushiroku Mynoghra
2025-07-06.desc:
* Based on a dark fantasy isekai light novel series written by Kazuno Fehu and illustrated by Jun.

Ira Takuto succumbed to illness at a young age and ended up reincarnating in a world that resembles the fantasy turn-based strategy game Eternal Nations. Not only did he reincarnate into his favourite game, but as the god who commands the evil civilisation Mynoghra. With Mynoghra's beautiful hero unit, Sludge Witch Atou by his side, not even legendarily difficult race traits will stand in the way of restarting their civilisation!

Source: Cross Infinite World

Note: The first episode received an early screening at Anime Messe Babelsberg in Germany on 5 July 2025. The regular TV broadcast started on 6 July 2025.

2025-07-06.name: Jibaku Shounen Hanako-kun 2 (2025)
2025-07-06.desc: * Based on a supernatural comedy shounen manga by Aida Iro.

2025-07-06.name: Kaoru Hana wa Rin to Saku
2025-07-06.desc:
Chidori High is a boys' school that takes in the dregs of society with the lowest grades. Next door stands Kikyo Girls' High, where wealthy, high-class families send their precious daughters.

Chidori second-year Rintarou, who has a fierce face but a gentle heart, is helping at his family's patisserie when he meets a girl named Kaoruko. The two hit it off right away but this blissful peace is quickly disturbed when Rintarou discovers that Kaoruko is actually a student at Kikyo. Worse, she doesn't seem to realize what a huge problem this really is! Will these two be able to forge a path for themselves, and sidestep the traps (metaphorical and literal) laid by their classmates?

Source: Kodansha

Note: The first two episodes received an early screening at a special event on 29 June 2025 at TOHO Cinemas Roppongi Hills in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 6 July 2025.

2025-07-06.name: Nyaight of the Living Cat
2025-07-06.desc:
Run! The Adorable Cats Are Here

In 20XX, the world is dominated by cats. A virus which turns anyone who touches a cat into a cat has spread into a worldwide nyandemic. Cats rub against people, turning them into cats. Can humanity fight their urge to pet cats to survive in this cat-ridden world?

Source: Crunchyroll

2025-07-06.name: Ruri no Houseki
2025-07-06.desc:
High schooler Tanigawa Ruri loves shiny things. She loves them so much that she heads into the mountains to search for crystals herself—where she unexpectedly meets Arato Nagi, a graduate student studying mineralogy. As the pair start collecting minerals together, Ruri begins developing a genuine appreciation for science and the beauty of the natural world.

Source: Crunchyroll

Note: The first episode received an early screening at a special event on 28 June 2025 in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 6 July 2025.

2025-07-06.name: Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi o Suru (2025)
2025-07-06.desc:
* Based on a love comedy cosplay manga by Fukuda Shin'ichi.

When Kitagawa Marin and Gojou Wakana met, they grew close over their love for cosplay. Through interacting with classmates and making new cosplay friends, Marin and Wakana's world keeps growing. New developments arise as Marin's love for Wakana continues to be filled with endless excitement. In their ever-expanding world, Marin and Wakana's story of cosplay and thrills continues!

Source: Crunchyroll

Note: The first two episodes received an early screening at a special event on 29 June 2025 at Ikebukuro HUMAX Cinemas in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 6 July 2025.

2025-07-06.name: Yuusha Party o Tsuihou Sareta Shiro Madoushi, S Rank Boukensha ni Hirowareru: Kono Shiro Madoushi ga Kikakugai Sugiru
2025-07-06.desc:
One day, Lloyd, a white mage, is banished from the hero's party. Lloyd, who has lost his job, happens to accompany an S-rank party on a quest by chance. At that time, no one knew that the hero’s party would collapse and Lloyd would gain fame - yet. This is the story of an extraordinary support magic-user who thinks he is normal, becomes an adventurer, while he is unaware of how he eventually becomes peerless.

Source: M-U

2025-07-07.name: Binan Koukou Chikyuu Bouei Bu Haikara!
City the Animation
2025-07-07.desc:
* Based on a surreal-slapstick manga series by Arawi Keiichi.

Midori is in a bit of a bind. She is in debt, and her landlady is trying to shake her down for unpaid rent. Her best friend refuses to loan her cash since she's wised up to her tricks. Maybe some bullying would help. Or a bit of petty theft? Neither is sustainable. Maybe getting a job would settle things... But working means less time for fun adventures in the big city...

Source: Kodansha

Note: The first three episodes received an early screening at a special event on 31 May 2025 at Namba Parks Cinema in Osaka and at MOVIX Kyoto, on 8 June 2025 at Shinjuku Piccadilly in Tokyo, on 14 June 2025 at MOVIX Sendai, and on 21 June 2025 at T-Joy Hakata in Fukuoka. The regular TV broadcast started on 7 July 2025.

2025-07-07.name: Cuckoo no Iinazuke Season 2
2025-07-07.desc:
* Based on a love comedy shounen manga by Yoshikawa Miki.

Umino Nagi and Amano Erika were born on the same day and swapped at birth. Nagi was raised as the son of a diner owner, and Erika the daughter of a hotel tycoon. Their parents encourage them to become engaged, and they begin life together. Soon though, infatuations arise as Nagi becomes stuck in a love quadrangle. Life and love are embroiled in epic turmoil as fate is set in motion once again!

Source: Crunchyroll

Note: The first episode received an early screening on 3 July 2025 at Anime Expo in Los Angeles. Additionally, the first episodes received an advance release on Kadokawa's YouTube channel on 7 July 2025. The regular TV broadcast started on 8 July 2025.

2025-07-07.name: Food Court de, Mata Ashita.
2025-07-07.desc:
To their classmates, Wada is a quiet rich girl while Yamamoto is an intimidating lone wolf...but what they don't know is that Wada is a mobile game addict in a passionate love-hate relationship (with a 2D character) and Yamamoto has a penchant for urban legends with eyes only for her favorite YouTuber. And their biggest not-so-secret secret—these unlikely friends meet at the food court every day after school to rant, rave, and learn what makes each other tick!

Source: Yen Press

Note: The first episode received an early screening at a special event on 13 June 2025 at Animate Ikebukuro in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 7 July 2025.

2025-07-07.name: Shinobanai! Crypto Ninja Sakuya San no Maki

2025-07-08.name: Grand Blue Season 2
2025-07-08.desc:
* Based on a manga series written by Inoue Kenji and illustrated by Yoshioka Kimitake.

Note: The first episode received an early screening at a special event on 14 June 2025 at United Cinemas Aqua City Odaiba in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 8 July 2025.

Additionally, the entire season got leaked in early July before its scheduled air date.

2025-07-08.name: Watashi ga Koibito ni Nareru Wakenai jan, Muri Muri! (*Muri ja Nakatta!?)
2025-07-08.desc:
Awkward, introverted Amaori Renako is leaving her lonely middle school life behind, determined to become an outgoing and popular high schooler. Glamorous, confident Ouzuka Mai is Renako's total opposite: wealthy, carefree, and a literal fashion model. Against the odds, the two girls form an immediate connection. Renako thinks she may have found the best friend of her dreams...until Mai's love confession sends her feelings into a tailspin. Renako wants to prove to Mai that being BFFs is better than being girlfriends, but Mai is dead set on convincing Renako that they're destined to be lovers!

Source: Seven Seas Entertainment

Note: The first episode received an early screening at a special event on 29 June 2025 at Kawasaki Cinecitta in Kawasaki. The regular TV broadcast started on 8 July 2025.

2025-07-09.name: Tate no Yuusha no Nariagari Season 4
2025-07-09.desc:
* Based on a fantasy adventure light novel series written by Aneko Yusagi and illustrated by Minami Seira.

As the Shield Hero, Iwatani Naofumi prepared for the return of the Phoenix, one of the Four Guardian Beasts. He tracked down each of the other three heroes and made his peace with them. But due to a misunderstanding, assassins from a nation called Q'ten Lo thought Raphtalia was going to try and take their throne, and tried to kill her. In order to work things out with Q'ten Lo, Naofumi travels to the demi-human country Siltvelt, the one place where he can get a boat to Q'ten Lo. He's welcomed warmly by the demi-humans there, who worship the Shield Hero. But even in Siltvelt there are those who aren't happy to see him. And he finds that Q'ten Lo is politically unstable as well, and that Raphtalia rapidly becomes a symbol for revolution. As things get more and more complex, will Naofumi become a light who guides his comrades?

Source: Official Website

2025-07-09.name: Turkey!
2025-07-09.desc:
"Turkey" is a bowling term for scoring three consecutive strikes.

Mai, a second-year student and captain of the Ikkokukan High School Bowling Club, is a genius who can't seem to win a match. Whenever she scores a Turkey, she mysteriously follows it up with an unyielding split—the Snake Eyes. One day, Rina, the club's only first-year member, confronts her

"You're doing it on purpose, aren't you?"
"You're running away from winning. But I want to win. If you have no intention of winning, I'll quit."

This is the story of Mai, Rina, Sayuri, Nozomi, and Nanase—five members of the Ikkokukan High School Bowling Club. They fight, they fall, but they rise again, chasing victory. This is the tale of a summer's final chapter.

Source: Official Website

Note: The first episode received an early screening at a special event on 18 May 2025 at Kamiyamada Cultural Hall in Chikuma. Additionally, the first two episodes received an early screening at a special event on 1 June 2025 at T-Joy Prince Shinagawa in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 9 July 2025.

2025-07-09.name: Xin Yichang Shengwu Jianwen Lu: Xu
2025-07-09.desc:
Hao Ren was originally a young man who lived in a fourth-tier city and lived on the meager rent of an old house. When he went out to work, he accidentally became a "universe police officer." While he was still struggling to accommodate a group of abnormal creature tenants arranged by his superiors, his jurisdiction, the Dream Plane Universe, had already brewed a cosmic crisis. The mystery of the origin of abnormal creatures on Earth and the ruins of civilization in the Dream Plane Universe seem to be connected in some way.

As Hao Ren's investigation deepened, the eldest son's world-destroying natural disaster, the goddess of creation fell, and one after another of the dusty and terrifying cases that had been buried for thousands of years bombarded his already useless brain circuit. Hao Ren gradually realized that he might not be able to slack off...

source: MAL

2025-07-10.name: Dr. Stone: Science Future (2025)
2025-07-10.desc:
* Based on an adventure sci-fi shounen manga series written by Inagaki Riichirou and illustrated by Boichi.

Note: The first three episodes received an early screening at a special event on 28 June 2025 at TOHO Cinemas Hibiya in Tokyo and six additional venues across Japan. The regular TV broadcast started on 10 July 2025.

2025-07-10.name: Kizu Darake Seijo yori Houfuku o Komete
2025-07-10.desc:
Lua was a saintess candidate who wielded the power of healing, but her ability had one flaw: she could only directly heal herself, and would heal others by transferring their wounds onto her own body. Because of this, others bullied her, calling her the "Broken Saintess". But it didn't bother Lua, because her best friend Arianne always stood up for her.

One day, Lua's crush, Commander Garrett, was on the brink of death from a beast attack. Lua healed him, which left her on the verge of death. When she woke up, she learned that all the credit was given to Arianne, who seized the opportunity to get engaged to Garrett, and she finally saw her best friend's true colors. Devastated, Lua was lost and helpless when the second prince appeared in front of her with a tempting offer: to join him on the path of revenge.

Source: manga via ANN (edited)

2025-07-10.name: Leviathan
2025-07-10.desc:
In 1914, on the eve of war, a fugitive prince and a girl in disguise meet aboard a bioengineered airship, the HMS Leviathan, and change the course of history.

Source: Netflix

2025-07-10.name: Mikadono San Shimai wa Angai, Choroi.
2025-07-10.desc:
Though Ayase Yuu is the son of a renowned and talented actress, he is below average in anything he does. He is entrusted to live under the care of his mother's friend, and later discovers that he will also be rooming with the three sisters from his school who possess both beauty and talent. Though Yuu thought that an understanding would be impossible to reach between an ordinary person and those blessed with talent, the three sisters are surprisingly...?!

Source: M-U

Note: The first three episodes received an early screening at a special event on 21 June 2025 at United Cinemas Aqua City Odaiba in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 10 July 2025.

2025-07-10.name: New Panty & Stocking with Garterbelt
2025-07-10.desc:
Daten City: A place on the fault line between heaven and hell. Once again, terrifying <ghosts> are silently corrupting the town. In times like these, there are those who banish <ghosts>, born from human desires and grudges, with a light beyond human comprehension. Their names are the angels, Panty & Stocking!! The fallen angel sisters with a mission to cleanse the pervasive darkness on Earth. Are they truly messengers of God... or servants of the Devil?

Source: Official Website

Note: The first episode received an early screening on 4 July 2025 at Anime Expo in Los Angeles. The regular TV broadcast started on 10 July 2025.

2025-07-10.name: Tensei Shitara Dai Nana Ouji Datta no de, Kimama ni Majutsu o Kiwamemasu Dai 2 Ki
2025-07-10.desc:
The study of magic requires aptitude, effort, and the right bloodline. One sorcerer loved magic, despite lacking the bloodline and aptitude for it, and died wishing he'd spent more time studying in life. He reawakens as Lloyd, the seventh prince of the Kingdom of Saloum, with all his previous memories intact. Blessed with a strong magical bloodline, he uses his gifts to master the study of magic.

After a victorious battle against Guisarme in the Lordost region, Lloyd's pursuit of magic knows no bounds. His next goal? Holy Magic! To learn this sacred art, Lloyd and his companions visit a church, but what awaits them there...?

Source: Official Website

2025-07-10.name: Wo Wei Dao Zong
2025-07-10.desc:
In a conspiracy, the supreme leader of the martial arts world, Dao Zong, was killed, and the leaders of various gangs were either killed or imprisoned, leaving the martial arts world in chaos. In order to rebuild the order of the martial arts world, Yan Jiyu, the leader of Changfeng Pavilion, sent messengers to various sects, intending to establish a new "righteous" martial arts world headed by him. However, at this time, the fledgling Yang Ren was entrusted to deliver a letter left by Dao Zong. Along the way, he was surrounded by powerful enemies and was extremely dangerous, but he relied on his passion and chivalry to constantly break through himself and defeat his opponents. While his martial arts skills improved rapidly, he also met a group of chivalrous and righteous people. What should the martial arts world look like? Yang Ren couldn't answer, but he knew it was definitely not what Yan Jiyu said. Yang Ren put up a big banner: "Chengfeng Gang", and quickly gathered together.

source: MAL

2025-07-11.name: Di Ling Ai: Mo Shui Linglong
2025-07-11.desc:
All things have spirits, and the power of nature gathers into various fairies with consciousness. However, because humans do not cherish nature and the forbidden power awakens, the fairies are hurt. A human girl met a fairy from the bottom of the water and knew him for many years. But the two could not cross the gap between fairies and humans. During the wonderful journey, the girl is determined to find her own power. She believes that humans are also part of nature, and there must be a way for humans and nature to coexist harmoniously. Can she protect nature?

source: bangumi.tv/googletranslate

2025-07-11.name: Futari Solo Camp
2025-07-11.desc:
* Based on a camping slice of life manga by Debata Yuudai.

Kinokura Gen loves camping solo. He enjoys the quiet solitude away from the hustle and bustle of the city, and being able to appreciate nature all by himself. But on one camping trip, his solitude is broken by the appearance of Kusano Shizuku, a young woman who wanted to camp solo herself, but is ill-prepared and completely out of her league. While he tries to to get her to go home so he can camp in peace, she refuses, and stubbornly insists on accompanying him on future camping trips until she's ready to camp solo. Thus Gen and Shizuku's days of solo camping together begin.

Source: M-U

2025-07-11.name: Tougen Anki
2025-07-11.desc:
Ichinose Shiki's blood is Oni, and his father's is Momotarou. Normally, those with Momotarou blood hunt the Oni—but Shiki's father refused to kill him as an infant. Instead, he adopted Shiki and raised him despite the rebellious attitude and dangerous temper that comes with Oni blood. When a member of the Momotarou Agency kills Shiki's father, he vows to avenge hm. But as Shiki hones his abilities and learns to control his Oni blood, will he be strong enough to survive the dangers waiting for him...?

Source: Yen Press

Note: The first episode received an early screening at a special event on 7 June 2025 at AFA Indonesia in Jakarta. Additionally, the first three episodes received an early screening at a special event on 21 June 2025 at United Cinemas Toyosu in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 11 July 2025.

2025-07-12.name: Douluo Dalu: Jiandao Chen Xin
2025-07-12.desc:
Twenty years before the final Douluo battle, the Spirit Hall had conspired to unify the entire spirit master world and annex all the sects. The Seven Treasures Glazed Tile Sect was the first to be hit and fell into danger. Bone Douluo brought the sect's young master, the five-year-old Ning Rongrong, to ask Sword Douluo to rescue them. So Sword Douluo Chenxin took little Rongrong on a life-and-death escape. However, what they didn't know was that behind this road was a huge conspiracy that would affect Douluo Continent...

source: MAL

2025-07-13.name: Shuukan Ranobe Anime
2025-07-13.desc:
An anthology project of original short episodes based on stories created by light novel authors and illustrators.

  • Shōshin Time Leap (傷心タイムリープ, Shōshin Taimurīpu; lit. "Heartbreak Time Leap") by Nigojū with character designs by tanu

  • Femme Fatale Ikusei Keikaku (ファムファタル育成計画, Famufataru Ikusei Keikaku; lit. "Femme Fatale Raising Project") by Natsu Hyūga with character designs by Kamoku Okeno

  • Jack the Reaper by Tappei Nagatsuki with character designs by Minori Chigusa

  • Marie Antoinette ni Tensei Shita node, Zenryoku de Guillotine o Kaihi Shimasu (マリー・アントワネットに転生したので全力でギロチンを回避します, Marī Antowanetto ni Tensei Shita node, Zenryoku de Girochin o Kaihi Shimasu. lit. "Reborn as Marie Antoinette, I'll Give it My All to Avoid the Guillotine")


Note: Some stories were realesed in parts in vertical format on YouTube and other streaming platforms from 12 May.

2025-07-14.name: Yami Shibai 15
2025-07-14.desc:
This short-form horror series uses the classic "paper drama" storytelling style to present some of Japan's most bizarre urban legends in a modern anime format.

Source: Crunchyroll

2025-07-15.name: Sakamoto Days (2025)
2025-07-15.desc: Note: The first two episodes received an early screening at a special event on 15 June 2025 at TOHO Cinemas Shinjuku in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 15 July 2025.

2025-07-16.name: Bullet/Bullet
2025-07-16.desc:
In the near future, civilization has collapsed. Gear works in a junk shop, retrieving stolen goods alongside Qu-0213 and Shirokuma. After accepting a mysterious request to steal an important item, they soon find themselves hunted by deadly assassins.

Source: Hulu

2025-07-17.name: Tong Ling Fei 2
2025-07-17.desc:
Qian Yunxi, the eldest daughter of the prime minister of Guyu Kingdom, has supernatural powers. She has been considered an unlucky person since she was a child and is forced to marry into the Ye Palace. Seeing her sincerity and kindness, the prince Ye Youming uses thousands of tricks to show his kindness. Qian Yunxi thinks that the prince has bad intentions, so she fights with him. A chaotic cohabitation life begins.

source: MAL

2025-07-17.name: Utagoe wa Mille-Feuille
2025-07-17.desc: Note: The first episode received an early screening at a special event on 13 July 2025 at Hitotsubashi Hall in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 17 July 2025.

2025-07-17.name: Yao Shen Ji Di Jiu Ji
2025-07-17.desc:
The original episode 381 of Tales of Demons and Gods is the first episode of Tales of Demons and Gods Season 9.
Nie Li and the Holy Son of Yan Yang worked together to trick the Holy Son of Li Huo and escaped from the Shadow Palace. In the battle of acting leader, Long Tianming colluded with the masters of the Demon God Sect to severely injure Situ Beiyan. Nie Li recovered the descendants of the gods from the border to join the battle, turned the tide and defeated Long Tianming. The leader of the Yu Shen Sect officially passed the throne to Nie Li. The spirit god Yu Yan reminded Nie Li to return to the Xiao Linglong world to find the "Book of Time and Space Demon Spirits". Nie Li went to the Tianyin Divine Sect to recall Ye Ziyun and Xiao Ning'er, opened the seal of the Xiao Linglong world, and saved the City of Glory from hanging.

source: movie.douban.com/googletranslate

2025-07-18.name: Cang Lan Jue 2
2025-07-18.desc:
Dongfang Qingcang returns to Cangyan Sea after the battle, but unexpectedly falls into the trap set by Peacock Military Advisor. On the other hand, the God of War Chidi frequently appears in Xiaolanhua's dream. What does that mean? Halfway through the journey of enemies between Dongfang Qingcang and Xiaolanhua, the Shadow Three Realms, which is free from the Three Realms, enters everyone's field of vision, and a huge secret concerning the balance of the Three Realms gradually surfaces.

source: bangumi.tv/googletranslate

2025-07-18.name: Gekijouban Kimetsu no Yaiba: Mugen-jou Hen
2025-07-18.desc: * Based on an action fantasy shounen manga by Gotouge Koyoharu.

2025-07-18.name: Long Zu II: Daowangzhe Zhi Tong
2025-07-18.desc:
Ominous rainstorms, strange black shadows, mysterious black suitcases, and "Odin" in armor descending like a god... Dancing long swords, exploding meteors, deserted highways, useless fathers turning into majestic heroes, fighting for their lives, who will win? Who will lose? And Lu Mingfei, welcoming his first summer vacation at Kassel Academy, received a temporary mission invitation from the school! The dragons are back, and the crisis is reappearing! The king of the earth and the mountain opened his eyes in chaos, the god Odin raised his spear and looked down at all living things, and a new storm in the dragon world is ready to go... Where should those young people go?

source: bangumi.tv/googletranslate

2025-07-18.name: Tooi-san wa Seishun Shitai! "Baka to Sumaho to Romance to"

2025-07-19.name: Kaijuu 8 Gou (2025)
2025-07-19.desc: Note: The first two episodes received an early screening at a special event on 13 July 2025 at TOHO Cinemas Hibiya in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 19 July 2025.

2025-07-19.name: Nukitashi the Animation
2025-07-19.desc:
Seiran Island, the tropical remote island, is home to Tachibana Junnosuke and his young sister, Asane, who return here from the mainland as a result of their parents' death. However, Seiran Island has become a dystopia where, to stop the decline of population, authorities have enforced the "Pervert Law." Sex is permitted and encouraged anywhere on the island, and those who refuse any sexual acts will be punished as a criminal offense. Being a cherry-picker who takes pride in his virginity, Junnosuke is skeptical about the law, thus, he sets up an anti-mating force, NLNS (No Love No Sex) to protect himself and his innocent sister, making headway to destroy the perverted law!

Source: OceanVeil

Note: The first three episodes received an early screening at a special event on 22 June 2025 at Cinem@rt Shinjuku in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 19 July 2025.

Note: The anime has 3 versions - fully regulated version for regular TV audiences, less censored streaming-only version, and the least regulated "Seiran Island" version distributed on AT-X and Blu-ray.

2025-07-22.name: Fei Ren Zai 3
2025-07-22.desc:
How do the "famous" spirits in Chinese classical mythology survive in modern society? They have become the homebodies, sweet men, office workers, and dog-like boyfriends with fairy-like characteristics around us. They perform funny and bizarre little stories in life that are about happiness and friendship, and construct an incredible two-dimensional fairyland in our ordinary and busy daily life.

source: bgm.tv\googletranslate

2025-07-23.name: Shuangsheng Wu Hun
2025-07-23.desc:
Lin Fan, born into a prestigious family in Dalin County, was once a celebrated genius chosen by the Heavenly Prodigy Token. However, his life takes a tragic turn when his fiancée steals his Martial Soul, leaving him powerless and disgraced. Just as his life hits rock bottom, a mysterious Great Demon attaches itself to him, reigniting his shattered Martial Soul and awakening a rare Dual Martial Soul Constitution. Empowered with this newfound strength, Lin Fan begins his journey of revenge and self-discovery, rising from obscurity in a small county town to battling his way through countless realms and dimensions across the universe.

source: themoviedb.org

2025-07-24.name: Karaoke Iko!
2025-07-24.desc:
Nothing worries Oka Satomi more than the upcoming final choir competition of his middle school career -- right up until he is accosted by a stranger from the shadows who demands, "Let's go karaoke!" As a yakuza, Narita Kyouji doesn't scare easily, but a terrifying prospect has driven him to seek Satomi's help. The boss is holding a karaoke contest, with the loser forced to get a tattoo to be selected and torturously applied by the boss himself! Oka has been to many vocal rehearsals over the years, but never one-on-one karaoke sessions with a gangster!!

Source: Yen Press

2025-07-24.name: My Melody & Kuromi
2025-07-24.desc:
My Melody opens a cake shop in Mariland. After encountering a heart in the forest, strange things start happening around her. Meanwhile, Kuromi's Japanese sweets shop across the street is always empty. Kuromi searches for the secret to My Melody's cakes. My Melody and Kuromi work hard to prepare for a sweets-making contest judged by the world-famous pastry chef Pistachio. However, no one knows that this will lead to an incident that threatens the fate of Mariland.

Source: Netflix

2025-07-27.name: Zaixia "Yingtai"
2025-07-27.desc:
The 2025 Chinese comic series with a heroine as the lead is coming, watch the academy team solve the chaos in the court!

source: bangumi.tv/googletranslate

2025-07-30.name: Zi Chuan 2
2025-07-30.desc:
"There are many ways to clear suspicion. Verbal excuses are only one, but also the most ineffective. Strength is also a way to justify it!"
Zichuan Xiu, the general who single-handedly killed the Zichuan family traitor in the demon camp, has become the leader of hundreds of thousands of allied forces in the Far East with the support of the guardian elders of the mysterious holy temple in the Far East. A new King of the Far East—the King of Light—has been born!

source: bangumi.tv/googletranslate
